summary: The toml inventory plugin uses a TOML file as an inventory source; the file must have a .toml extension.
questions: Can I write my Ansible inventory in TOML?
What file extension does a TOML inventory need?

answer_card.title: TOML inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.toml` reads a TOML-format inventory. The file **must** have a `.toml` extension.
